Instinctual predator prey habits have been long forgotten by these unfortunate beasts, replaced by an unnameable horror and yearning to flee. Their cries are soundless, as if they fear to gain their tormentors' attention by causing a sound, rather their eyes scream in silent agony. Some of the cages even contain recognizable humanoid figures. Here, a tenacious Vorngar, his once strongly muscled body is now gaunt and emaciated. There, a human, his dark hair grown long and ragged, his eyes feral. Even a rare Seraphim has been locked into a too small cage, her flaming limbs faded to sputtering embers.

The area is illuminated.

In this room you see: Chappy the Varanus,  Perception the Zacotl
Obvious exits are: west

Perception searches the room carefully.

Chappy's group just went west.

You follow Chappy...


[Dremsyl's Tower, Basement Laboratory]
The dead bodies of dozens of unfortunate animals dangle from tarnished chains on the ceiling, their throats slit, allowing their blood to slowly drip down to the stone floor. Thin rivulets of fresh blood stream across the stone floor toward a rusted metal grate in the center of the room. Some of the suspended beasts still struggle futilely, not quite dead yet, but no hope for survival. One animal in particular, an unrecognizable canine, tries to whimper in terror, but only manages to wheeze painfully as its deep brown eyes begin to glaze over and its vain struggles finally cease.

[Dremsyl's Tower, Basement Laboratory]

[Dremsyl's Tower, Basement Laboratory]
Softly glowing lights hover just above a work table; each colored orb hums with a strange inhuman voice. A small bird struggles vainly to escape from cruel chains that pin it to the tabletop, it screeches in pain and terror as a green sphere of light floats toward it. With a sudden blinding flash, the light is absorbed into the panicked bird, its screeching becomes louder and more frantic then suddenly alters in pitch, becoming deeper and more human sounding for just a moment before it fades away. [Dremsyl's Tower, Shrine to Karishta]
A massive tiled mosaic of a ten-head hydra in the throes of casting some grand, unimaginable spell covers the entire far wall and ceiling of the room. [Dremsyl's Tower, Shrine to Cassien]
Slender tentacles have crept into the temple of Cassien, unafraid of the tyrant god's wrath, and twined around pillars that were once beautiful. Now most of the obsidian and ruby inlaid columns have fallen to the ground, shattered by the crushing strength of the muscled appendages of the tower beast. A faded mural of a stalking panther covers the back wall, the intricate detail in the painting, suggests it was created by a true master of the craft in loving devotion of his vain god. An obsidian altar sits before the masterpiece, an exquisite carving of a goshawk, its wings outstretched once sat upon the volcanic stone, now it has fallen to the floor, one wing snapped off. No doubt the god Cassien has long since abandoned this place, but it still reeks of his power, and the tentacles of the fleshy monster feast off the residual magical energy of the shrine.

The area is illuminated.

[Temple of the Eyranas]
Amazingly the interior of the temple is teaming with life. Birds fly freely amongst the tall trees and shrubs which give the appearance of the outside instead of in. Small animals scurry across the ground in an almost permanent state of play. A large fountain set in the center of the area spouts water high into the air which then settles back into the fountain without even the smallest splash. Statues of the Goddess's lie scattered among the various ponds and gardens of the temple. A small grassy pasture free of any growth takes its place on the northeastern side of the temple which sits beneath a beautiful green, moss covered altar. A gaggle of bushes trimmed to portray letters spells out the word "Life" in the northwestern corner of the temple. A small path that leads through some thick overgrowth to the west provides passage to another room. To the south an overgrown arch provides exit back to the street.

The area is illuminated.
